newsitem.title: UK: ICI benefits from pre-results activity.
newsitem.headline: ICI benefits from pre-results activity.

text.p: Shares in Imperial Chemical Industries Plc were outperforming a firm stock market on Wednesday as players awaited first quarter results due Thursday.
ICI shares were up 17.5 pence at 722p by 1025 GMT on volume of 700,000, a 2.48 percent gain. The FTSE-100 index was up 37 points, or 0.86 percent, to 4,383 at the same time.
"Someone is obviously expecting a good set of figures," a trader at a British bank said, adding the stock had scope for improvement given its losses in recent months.
ICI hit an intra-day low at 679p early this month, the bottom of a six-month 25 percent fall from 889p.
Market forecasts for its first quarter pre-tax profits range from 75-90 million stg, averaging at 79 million stg, according to a recent Reuter survey.
The figure, which has been adjusted for a restructuring charge, comes after a 202 milion stg figure in the first quarter of 1996.
